simple.meaning: אָמֹץ (ʼâmôts) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet)
definitions.full: H554. amots [ אָמֹץ ] adjective strong , only plural אֲמֻצִּים of horses Zech 6:3 , 7 (in 6:7 perhaps read אֲדֻמִּים , compare 6:2 , & Hi; see another view in Lag BN 29 ).

occurrences.englishText: in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot dappled horses, all of them powerful.
The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth: and he said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.
